description: This file is a server implementation using Node.js with Express to provide an API for visualizing and interacting with various databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB). It loads environment variables, configures database clients, defines classes for database adapters, and sets up API endpoints for database info, tables, and table data.

classes.name: DatabaseAdapter
classes.description: Base class for database adapters, defines common interface and helper methods.

classes.name: SQLAdapter
classes.description: Abstract class extending DatabaseAdapter for SQL-based databases, implements execute and related methods.

methods.name: loadEnvFiles
methods.description: Loads environment variables from env files for each database type.

methods.name: testConnections
methods.description: Tests connection to each configured database.

methods.name: handleApiRequest
methods.description: Generic handler to process API requests for a given database adapter.
